scripts.check: bun run --cwd application/frontend check && bun run --cwd application/backend check
scripts.build: bun run --cwd application/frontend build && bun run --cwd application/backend build
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run check && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.audit: bun audit --audit-level=moderate && (cd application/backend && bun audit --audit-level=moderate) && (cd application/frontend && bun audit --audit-level=moderate)
